| **Word lengths: no serial structure, fewer 2-rune words than English** | 2-rune words 15.5% against 20-27% in English (rejected in runes, p about 10^-45); best simple fit: one extra rune in about 42% of multi-rune words (G 16.5, df 10, p 0.085); spelling TH as T + H explains most of it (G 223 -> 56) |
| **Flat unigrams and bigrams, no coincidence peak at any lag, no literal-F excess, repeated 6-gram DJU-BEI** | 458 ciphertext F against 447 +/- 21 expected (z +0.5): LP2 does not follow the solved pages' literal-F convention in one layer; the repeated 6-gram DJU-BEI has chance probability 0.16 (P(>= 1)). 2026-10-18 sharper finding: DJU and BEI are two 3-rune words, each occurring exactly twice, always as the adjacent pair DJU->BEI - the ONLY repeated adjacent word-pair in all 2,887 pairs of LP2 (within-section word-shuffle null: P(any pair >= 2 occurrences) = 0.016, P(DJU->BEI >= 2) = 0 of 1000), and the second occurrence is the book's final two words (0.15 ends ... CEAIMCX DJU BEI) 2026-10-21, community (Mike, CicadaSolvers Discord; replicated here only in part): both DJU BEI copies are word-aligned 3+3 (rune 6555, 28 runes into 27.jpg; and the last 6 runes of 55.jpg); word-length shuffles within sections give that alignment in 0.26% (20,000 shuffles), and none of the 129 four-rune or 6 five-rune repeats is word-aligned (0.2 expected): one event, not a word-bound key |
| **Power of the chanscreen v2 contract when the plaintext is spelled letter by letter (TH as T + H, no digraph runes)** | Letter-spelled: 200 of 200 detected at 300 runes (50 of 50 per channel, winner sign correct in 198); prefixes 180 of 200 at 60 runes (hold 44, spend 40, skip5 48, coin 48), 200 of 200 from 80 runes up. The n300 and clause-scan negatives hold for letter-spelled English; only clauses of about 60 runes lose some power (90% against 97%) *(The digraph E4 of the same plants: 200 of 200 at 300 runes, 194 of 200 at 60 runes)* |
| **One word-aware collision-repair mechanism for the doublet deficit and the lag-5 / lag-6 echoes together (M0-M7)** | No mechanism reproduces every anomaly: no Level 2 lead. A shared repair budget (M2, a = 0.8-1.0) reproduces the doublet deficit, the lag-6 relation (0.0203-0.0257 vs LP2 0.0275 per pair) and the lag-5 echo (0.0106-0.0138 vs 0.0144) with zero excess across word gaps and flat unigrams / bigrams. None reproduces the S carrier of the lag-5 echo (S5 2-3 vs 11) or the word-length histogram (insertion at repairs moves G by < 8). Prediction 'lag-6 hits are independent': LP2 6 multi-hit words, 3 consecutive (M1 plants 4.2 +- 2.2, 2.4 +- 1.7): met, but not discriminating. Follow-ups (sections 7-8): the S carrier is calibrated at P < 0.002 over 29 sources x lags 2-8 (S 11 hits vs 2.3); English plaintext has S..S at lag 5 at 0.13 per S pair (-SELVES, SENSES), as LP2 (0.149), but no simulated cipher keeps the coincidence on cipher S (a period-5 key in 60% of words gives the overall lag-5 excess with S,S 3.2; a literal-S rule contradicts the flat S count). Word lengths: no plaintext spelling or language fits (letter-spelled English G 63-233 by text, Latin / German / Romance 253-1609; best one-parameter segmentation p 1e-4); Old English not tested. Section 9: the 11 S,S sites do not have the length / position shape of English S____S words (LLR -10.8; English-S shape P < 5e-5, other-rune shape P 0.43), so the plaintext reading of the S carrier is disfavoured; the solved pages have no S carrier but no power (21-30 S pairs); a period-5 key in some words is not excluded (lag 10 has no power, P 0.09). Section 10: Old English (Beowulf, 1893 edition) and Middle English (Chaucer) do not fit the word lengths either (G 242-1057, every variant rejected); Old English prose, the Rune Poem and Welsh not tested *(M0 (uniform repair) and M7 (wrong map) reproduce the doublets and no echo; the measurement script reproduces LP2's logged numbers (lag 6 in-word 80 / 44.5, z +5.32))* |
| **Do LP2's keyless signals interact? Isomorphs (incl. DJU BEI under 812 affine maps), S lag-5 x lag-6 overlap, echo-bearing words vs the +1 length model** | No coupling found: isomorphs at the low end of the nulls; DJU BEI matches only itself under the 812 maps; S x lag-6 same word 2 vs 1.45 expected (no co-location, no avoidance); echo-bearing words are as long as their selection predicts (+0.08 to +0.29 runes). Verdict: independent quirks, not shown to be one mechanism *(Planted 50% co-location of the two echo sites detected 85%; planted periodic / progressive English keys NOT recovered by the isomorph test (<= 11%: low power); +1 coupling at pi = 0.3 detectable 15%)* |

Community leads checked (phase 46): 'CicadaPG v.3301' as the An End preimage 0 of 90; the page-55 affine relation (10 of 73) equals the best-of-841 null's 95th percentile; the DJU BEI 'TRUTH' overlay cannot be a rune-wise difference (the copies are identical) *(Planted 2x2 Hill recovered by the block test; nulls as stated in the log)* |

LP2 has 83 one-rune words (community: 100). Past hits: best oracle fraction 0.40 (real) / 0.22 (null), none >= 0.5, none flagged. As a screen: power 0.97-1.00 but about 330x the cost of one IoC decode per stream-offset over a whole section; best used as a verifier and post-filter of IoC / LM hits *(Planted 0.3-text keys (13-25 one-rune words): power 0.95-1.00; random offsets: path-averaged mean 0.068 (q99.9 0.16-0.24), best-path mean 0.30-0.34 with a heavy tail (max 1.00 in the 13-word case))* |

Subsequent three-scale lower-dispersion site test (section/100 eligible/gaps), B=999: raw p=.024/.030/.687; Bonferroni .072/.090/1.000, omnibus .072, no flag. Conditional Bernoulli site null, not exact forward cipher. Pure-null selected-lag6-affine optimism +26.54 counts does not correct 80 (zero fixed-T6/tail matches). Retrospective checks, NOT untouched replication. Discriminator held *(Old selection-pipeline full plants 3/4, null clear; old selected-rule split 0/4 (LP2 selected-rule split not run). NEW fixed-rule controls: I5 2/2 per half, T6 1/2 in A and 2/2 in B, null clear; coarse gates pass. 27/27 fixed-halves tests per invocation. Subsequent dispersion controls: 0/4 Bernoulli flags, 4/4 evenly spaced flags with matched total and one-site marginals; 28/28 tests per invocation. Exact reference spend/hold count-test power .260650 at size .05; actual-site power unknown)* |
